title.en: The One With the Frozen Breakfast

description.es: Marta y Fina le preparan el desayuno a Isidro. Marta y Fina le dicen a Isidro que no se van a ir a Barcelona. Marta dice que, con Fina a su lado, no se convertirá en alguien como su familia por culpa de su ambición, ya que Fina es su mayor apoyo. Mientras desayunan juntos, entra Damián, y el ambiente se congela. Damián le pide a Fina que ayude a Marta a perdonarlo. Fina le responde que Marta solo quiere ser aceptada tal como es y vivir tal como es, y que, más allá de eso, ella no puede meterse en el asunto que hay entre ellos.
description.en: Marta and Fina prepare breakfast for Isidro. Marta and Fina tell Isidro that they will not be going to Barcelona. Marta says that with Fina by her side she will not turn into someone like her family because of her ambition, since Fina is her greatest support. As they have breakfast together, Damián comes in, and the atmosphere turns icy. Damián asks Fina to help Marta forgive him. Fina replies that Marta only wants to be accepted as she is and to live as she is, and that beyond that she cannot get involved in the matter between them.
